description: Paginate entities linked to one parent MBID. Accepted parents by target: artist → area, recording, release, release-group, work; label → area, release; release-group → artist, release; release → area, artist, label, recording, release-group, track_artist; recording → artist, release, work; work → artist. track_artist enumerates releases crediting an artist on tracks but not at release level. Artist release-groups and release-group editions embed one upstream page in get_* lookups; use this tool for the complete entity set. Recording browse returns identities, not performance attributes/dates or ordered release tracks: use musicbrainz_get_recording for work relationships and musicbrainz_get_release for tracks. Provide exactly one valid parent link. offset pages to any depth; totalCount is the exact filtered upstream entity total. Optional type/status filters apply only on supported parent pairs; preserve applied filters on continuation. Release rows carry status, other entity subtypes use type; release-groups include secondaryTypes and recordings include firstReleaseDate when available.

limit.description: Positive integer page size (default 25); values above 100 are clamped to 100 with a notice. With MUSICBRAINZ_CLAMP_OVERSIZED_LIMITS=off, maximum 100 is enforced.

link.description: Exactly one parent MBID. The valid key depends on target_type (see the description).

area.description: Parent area MBID (artists, labels, or releases in this area).

artist.description: Parent artist MBID (e.g. release-groups/recordings/releases by this artist).

label.description: Parent label MBID (releases on this label).

recording.description: Parent recording MBID (artists or releases linked to this recording).

release.description: Parent release MBID (artists, labels, release-groups, or recording entities in this edition; recordings are not ordered tracks).

release-group.description: Parent release-group MBID (releases in this group).

releaseGroup.description: Alias for release-group; use only one spelling.

release_group.description: Alias for release-group; use only one spelling.

track_artist.description: Artist MBID for release-only browse: releases crediting the artist on tracks but not at release level.

work.description: Parent work MBID (artists or recordings linked to this work).

status.description: Pipe-separated statuses for release by artist/label/recording/release-group/track_artist: official, promotion, bootleg, pseudo-release, withdrawn, cancelled. Tokens are trimmed/lowercased and unioned; blank means absent.

target_type.description: The entity type to enumerate (the children).

type.description: Pipe-separated release types: album, single, ep, broadcast, other, audio drama, audiobook, compilation, demo, dj-mix, field recording, interview, live, mixtape/street, remix, soundtrack, spokenword. Supported for release-group by artist and release by artist/label/recording/track_artist. Primary types union; primary and secondary categories intersect; release-group by artist requires all secondary types. Tokens are trimmed/lowercased; blank means absent.

name: musicbrainz_browse_entities

cap.description: The page size that was applied. Absent when not truncated.

entities.description: This page of linked entities, in upstream order.

items.description: A lightweight reference to a linked entity.

artistCredit.description: Credited artist string, for release-group/release/recording. Omitted otherwise.

country.description: Country code, where applicable. Omitted when absent.

date.description: First-release/release date, where applicable. Omitted when absent.

firstReleaseDate.description: Recording first-release date, possibly partial. Omitted when absent.

length.description: Recording length as m:ss. Omitted when not a recording / unknown.

mbid.description: Entity MBID — chain to the matching musicbrainz_get_* tool.

secondaryTypes.description: Release-group secondary classifications in upstream order. Omitted when empty; absence does not establish a studio album.

status.description: Release status (e.g. Official or Bootleg). Omitted for other entity types or when absent.

type.description: Entity subtype, where applicable. Omitted when absent.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: A nonempty type/status filter has an unknown token, an empty pipe-list member, or is unsupported for the target and parent. `invalid_link`: A parent key is unknown, aliases collide, not exactly one nonempty parent is supplied, or the MBID/parent combination is invalid. `entity_not_found`: The link MBID is well-formed but no such parent entity exists (HTTP 404). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

linkMbid.description: The parent MBID that was browsed.

linkType.description: The parent link type used (artist, track_artist, label, release-group, release, recording, work, or area).

notice.description: How to page further when results remain, or guidance when empty.

offset.description: The offset used for this page.

shown.description: Number of entities returned in this page. Absent when not truncated.

status.description: Canonical applied pipe-separated status filter; preserve on continuation.

targetType.description: The entity type that was enumerated.

totalCount.description: True total number of linked entities upstream (the {type}-count field).

truncated.description: True when more entities remain beyond this page (offset + shown < totalCount). Absent when the page is complete.

type.description: Canonical applied pipe-separated type filter; preserve on continuation.

title: musicbrainz-mcp-server: browse entities
